title: Problem with eval and local test
body: Hi everything seems to be working fine during the regular training phase local train The agent appears to learn as expected However when I try to render local test or run test py the agent jumps once and then continuously moves to the right This issue seems to be caused by the difference in action selection methods In local train actions are selected using Categorical In local test and test py actions are selected using argmax Relevant Code Code in test py and local test python logits value h 0 c 0 model state h 0 c 0 policy F softmax logits dim 1 action torch argmax policy item action int action state reward done info env step action Code in local train python logits value h 0 c 0 local model state h 0 c 0 policy F softmax logits dim 1 log policy F log softmax logits dim 1 entropy policy log policy sum 1 keepdim True m Categorical policy action m sample item state reward done env step action I only trained for few thousand episodes before doing the tests but it seems off that the local train is learning while during test it can t even pass the first obstacle Using Categorical instead of Argmax during test also seems to fix the problem Is this intended Thanks for the patience and help

title: Question about hyperparameters
body: Hello I have some questions regarding the parameters you selected for the training process By default num local steps is set to 50 which seems quite low to me This means the agent can perform a maximum of 50 actions per episode during training before the environment resets Could you provide details about the parameters chosen for the following stages First world first stage First world second stage First world third stage Additionally for these levels did you conduct training across 100 000 episodes From the code it seems the default global steps variable is set to 5e6 implying a total of 100 000 episodes per level in each world since each episode consists of 50 steps Could you confirm if this interpretation is correct Thank you
